# Arch-loop follow-up row K -- PLA, nozzle 205C, bed 60C, M221 S100

**Not yet print-tested.** Generated by `arch_test.mjs ... K`. Printed on the **same bed** as `20261029_arch-loop-8-rows-PLA.gcode` -- don't clear the sheet. Row K sits at Y=165, above row J (Y 151).

Calibration line: `freeformSolid` x=120-180, y=30, printed first (the next free step in the calibration sequence; y=75 from the 8-row print and y=40 from row I and y=35 from row J are already on this bed). `verifyLayout` against everything already on the bed (3mm min gap): ok=true, 0 warnings.

**Change from row J** (everything else identical: H 3, S 3, 6 loops, same anchors, fan on):

| | row J | row K |
|---|---|---|
| arch strand e/d (rise, bridge, descent) | 0.075 | 0.075 (same) |
| path shape | square corners: straight up, across, down | lopsided parabola, peak at 0.9mm of 3.0mm (30%) |
| speed F (mm/min) | 75 / 75 / 100 (rise / bridge / descent) | 110 (whole curve) |
| arch path length, A to B (mm) | 8.1 | 6.2 |
| filament per arch (mm) | 0.607 | 0.466 |
| time for the whole arch (s) | 5.9 | 3.4 |
| average melt flow over the arch (mm3/s) | 0.25 | 0.33 |

No corners and no straight bridge: the nozzle climbs steeply from the start anchor (0.6 -> 3.0mm over the first 0.9mm), rounds the peak, then comes down over the remaining 2.1mm -- flat just after the peak and steepening into the end anchor, like a thrown ball's path. The strand is never dragged level through the air. Strand thickness is row J's; the speed is back up to 110mm/min because row J (75) printed too slow -- between row J and row I (150).

**No purge line**: the header's purge lines at X10-10.4, Y15-100 are left out (they would print on top of the ones already there). The calibration line is the first extrusion, so it doubles as the prime -- expect its start to be a little thin.

| row | Y | shape | dir | H (mm) | S (mm) | loops | pitch gap | rise / bridge / down F | top dwell | fan | ~mm3/s at bridge | note |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| K | 165 | parabola | x | 3.0 | 3.0 | 6 | 3.0 | 110 (whole curve) | - | on | 0.33 | row J's strand on a lopsided parabola (peak 30% of the way across, nearer the start anchor), at 110mm/min -- between row I (150) and row J (75) |

**What to look for**: compare directly with row J (Y=151). Did the loops keep the lopsided shape, with the high point near the start, or did they slump into a symmetric hump? Is the descending side smooth, or did it sag onto the bed before the end anchor? Compare stiffness with row J's square-cornered loops, and whether 110mm/min fixed what was wrong with row J's speed.

Totals: 1472 G-code lines, 10.7 mm commanded filament.
